headline: Google is rolling out direct Markdown file editing and previews in Docs and Drive, so people and AI agents can work on the same files without converting them.
score_reason: Useful housekeeping change that began rolling out on 5 Oct; limited reach and before the window, so score lowered by 1.
importance_line: People who keep notes or AI instructions in Markdown can edit them in Docs without conversion, and the rollout may take up to 15 days to reach everyone.
summary: 9to5Google reports that Google Drive and Google Docs are adding full native support for Markdown (.md) files, including real-time editing, comments and rendered previews in Drive, with no conversion to another format. Google says this helps people and AI agents collaborate on the same document, and the rollout started on 5 Oct 2026 and may take up to 15 days to reach everyone.
notes: gHacks original returned 403; read at 9to5Google (5 Oct 2026), which reports the same Google announcement. Rollout began before the window: score lowered by 1 (5 to 4).
